The mature RefSpec implementation now builds the vocabulary-only crosswalk and static asset from verified managed-release distributions. Exactly two supporting machine validations can qualify a mapping for searchOnly use when they resolve the pinned evidence, pass deterministic checks, and use distinct validator actors, independence groups, providers, provider model IDs, and response artifacts.
